python_importerror.title: Python ImportError recovery
python_importerror.condition: When Python raises `ImportError` during pytest collection, preserve the package layout.
python_importerror.detail: Check `sys.path`, the missing module name, and whether the test runner changed the working directory. Do not rewrite unrelated imports.

pytest_fixture_scope.title: pytest fixture scope
pytest_fixture_scope.condition: When a pytest fixture uses function scope, isolate mutable state from later tests.
pytest_fixture_scope.detail: Create the resource inside the fixture and close it in teardown. Do not store that resource on a session object.

pytest_asyncio.title: async function tests
pytest_asyncio.condition: When pytest runs a coroutine test, await the coroutine before asserting the result.
pytest_asyncio.detail: Mark the test with pytest-asyncio and close the event loop after the assertion. Do not call the coroutine without await.

git_apply.title: Git patch application
git_apply.condition: When git apply rejects a patch, run git apply --check before changing the source.
git_apply.detail: Compare the rejected hunk with the current file. Keep the patch limited to the reported lines and rerun the focused pytest.
